"""Domain profiles for the conflict engine (REFERENCE). Each is ~40 lines; a new domain = a new profile + tests."""
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import timedelta
from typing import Any, Optional

from conflict_engine import COMPATIBLE, OPPOSITE, SAME, UNKNOWN, Finding, Input, Subject, side


def _n(v: Any) -> str:
    return str(v or "").strip().upper().replace("-", "_").replace(" ", "_")


# ── 1. security stance (Watch, Home, CIO Desk, Advisory, Telegram escalations, Ask the CIO) ────────────────────────
BUY, HOLD, ASIDE, REDUCE = "buy", "hold", "stand_aside", "reduce"
_FAM = {**{k: BUY for k in ("ADD", "BUY", "ACCUMULATE", "RE_ENTER", "REENTER", "ENTER", "GO", "NEAR_ENTRY", "READY",
                            "BUY_READY", "ENTRY_NEAR")},
        **{k: HOLD for k in ("HOLD", "KEEP", "MAINTAIN")},
        **{k: ASIDE for k in ("WATCH", "AVOID", "PASS", "NO_GO", "NOGO", "WAIT")},
        **{k: REDUCE for k in ("TRIM", "SELL", "EXIT", "REDUCE")}}


def stance_action(v: Any, held: bool) -> Optional[str]:
    f = _FAM.get(_n(v))
    if f is None:
        return None
    if not held and f in (REDUCE, HOLD):
        return ASIDE                    # can't trim what you don't own; "hold" a non-position = stay out
    if held and f == ASIDE:
        return HOLD if _n(v) in ("WATCH", "WAIT") else REDUCE
    return f


@dataclass
class SecurityStanceProfile:
    name: str = "security_stance"
    canonical_source: str = "the CIO"
    canonical_max_age: timedelta = timedelta(hours=72)
    flap_limit: int = 3
    flap_window: timedelta = timedelta(days=7)
    supersede_days: dict = field(default_factory=lambda: {"watchlist CIO review": 14, "watchlist_final_synthesis": 3,
                                                           "agent_escalation": 2, "advisory_desk": 2,
                                                           "analyst_consensus": 30})
    taxable_accounts: frozenset = frozenset({"taxable_c"})

    def compare(self, a: Any, b: Any, s: Subject) -> str:
        held = bool(s.context.get("held"))
        x, y = stance_action(a, held), stance_action(b, held)
        if x is None or y is None:
            return UNKNOWN
        if x == y:
            return SAME if _n(a) == _n(b) else COMPATIBLE
        if held and {x, y} == {BUY, HOLD}:
            return COMPATIBLE           # add vs keep: same direction, different size
        return OPPOSITE

    def supersede_after(self, source: str) -> timedelta:
        return timedelta(days=self.supersede_days.get(source, 14))

    def gate_blocks(self, g: Input, canonical: Input, s: Subject) -> bool:
        if _n(g.value) in ("PASS", "OK", "CLEAR"):
            return False
        if g.source.startswith("wash_sale") and g.account and g.account not in self.taxable_accounts:
            return False                # wash-sale only matters in taxable accounts
        return stance_action(canonical.value, bool(s.context.get("held"))) == BUY

    def protection_finding(self, i: Input, s: Subject, canonical: Optional[Input]) -> Optional[Finding]:
        v = _n(i.value)
        if i.role == "protection" and s.context.get("held") and v in ("AWAITING_FILL", "PENDING_ACTIVATION", "NONE"):
            text = {"AWAITING_FILL": "Stop likely filled — broker fill not confirmed",
                    "PENDING_ACTIVATION": "Stop order pending activation — not protecting yet",
                    "NONE": "Held with no broker stop"}[v]
            return Finding("NEEDS_OPERATOR", "U0", text, "the broker shows the fill or an active stop, or you record "
                           "'no stop by plan'", "notify_operator", "operator", [side(i, self)])
        if i.role == "policy" and v == "BREACH":
            adding = canonical is not None and stance_action(canonical.value, bool(s.context.get("held"))) == BUY
            return Finding("NEEDS_OPERATOR" if adding else "GATE", "U0",
                           f"Policy limit: {i.detail or 'breached'}" + (" — and the CIO says add" if adding else ""),
                           "weight back under the limit, or you record an exception",
                           "notify_operator" if adding else "none", "operator" if adding else "block", [side(i, self)])
        if i.role == "safety" and v in ("ENGAGED", "BLOCKED", "LOCKED"):
            return Finding("GATE", "U0", f"{i.source} is {v.lower()} — nothing is actionable",
                           "the operator clears it on the host; never automatic", "none", "block", [side(i, self)])
        return None

    def describe(self, v: Any) -> str:
        return _n(v).replace("_", " ") or "—"

    def owner_review_action(self) -> str:
        return "queue_review"


# ── 2. numeric fact that several pages compute (portfolio total, day P&L, cash, position count) ──────────────────
@dataclass
class NumericFactProfile:
    name: str = "numeric_fact"
    canonical_source: str = "the canonical aggregate"
    canonical_max_age: timedelta = timedelta(hours=26)
    flap_limit: int = 3
    flap_window: timedelta = timedelta(days=7)
    abs_tolerance: float = 1.0          # dollars (or units) — rounding noise only
    rel_tolerance: float = 0.0          # money shown on two pages must match to the dollar; a metric that is
                                        # legitimately approximate (e.g. a model estimate) sets its own tolerance
    unit: str = "$"

    def compare(self, a: Any, b: Any, s: Subject) -> str:
        try:
            x, y = float(a), float(b)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            return UNKNOWN
        d = abs(x - y)
        if d <= self.abs_tolerance:
            return SAME
        if d <= abs(x) * self.rel_tolerance:
            return COMPATIBLE
        return OPPOSITE                 # a real mismatch: two pages would show different numbers

    def supersede_after(self, source: str) -> timedelta:
        return timedelta(days=2)

    def gate_blocks(self, g, canonical, s) -> bool:
        return False

    def protection_finding(self, i, s, canonical) -> Optional[Finding]:
        return None

    def describe(self, v: Any) -> str:
        try:
            return f"{self.unit}{float(v):,.2f}"
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            return str(v)

    def owner_review_action(self) -> str:
        return "notify_operator"        # a number mismatch is a data defect: fix the reader, never "decide"


# ── 3. schedule state (lane registry vs crontab vs n8n vs last successful run) ───────────────────────────────────
@dataclass
class ScheduleStateProfile:
    name: str = "schedule_state"
    canonical_source: str = "the lane registry"
    canonical_max_age: timedelta = timedelta(days=365)
    flap_limit: int = 3
    flap_window: timedelta = timedelta(days=7)
    _runs = {"ACTIVE": True, "LIVE": True, "RUNNING": True, "RETIRED": False, "PAUSED": False, "ABSENT": False,
             "NOT_SCHEDULED": False}

    def compare(self, a: Any, b: Any, s: Subject) -> str:
        x, y = self._runs.get(_n(a)), self._runs.get(_n(b))
        if x is None or y is None:
            return UNKNOWN
        return SAME if x == y else OPPOSITE

    def supersede_after(self, source: str) -> timedelta:
        return timedelta(days=3650)     # a crontab line is never "too old" to matter

    def gate_blocks(self, g, canonical, s) -> bool:
        return False

    def protection_finding(self, i, s, canonical) -> Optional[Finding]:
        return None

    def describe(self, v: Any) -> str:
        return _n(v).replace("_", " ").lower() or "—"

    def owner_review_action(self) -> str:
        return "notify_operator"        # schedule truth is an operator/coordinator decision (registry is §17-governed)


PROFILES = {p.name: p for p in (SecurityStanceProfile(), NumericFactProfile(), ScheduleStateProfile())}
